decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker default proposal lists 'Favorite toggle'; Round 1 client: 'use "read later" and archive rather than favorites'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Reference has no favorites; it specifies read-later (REF-BM-17..19) and archive (REF-BM-26..28). Maker's default proposes favorites → divergent. Client supplies the reference-conforming behaviour in place of the mismatch (also offered as 'favorites, or archive' in the menu, so a select aspect exists, but the client actively replaces with read-later+archive).

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker default: 'Search by text and filter by tag'; Round 1 client: 'search that can handle tags, exact phrases, and combinations such as AND/OR/NOT'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. The concrete default scope offers only plain text search + tag filter, omitting boolean operators, parenthesised groups, exact-phrase, and tag-search syntax. Client requests these related reference requirements → extend.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker default: 'Auto-fetch page title when you paste a URL'; Round 1 client: 'collect its title, description, icon, and preview image, while letting me edit them'.
decisions.note: Spec gate. Default only auto-fetches title; reference REF-BM-02 requires title+description+favicon+preview and REF-BM-03 editability. Client extends the collected metadata set and confirms editability. (Mechanism divergence addressed separately at round 2.)

decisions.note: Spec gate. The default CRUD, tags, tag-filter, plain text search and readable list conform to the reference; client accepts. Recorded conforming decision, no divergence.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker: '*Fetch* button pulls OG/meta tags via Cheerio' and 'On add/fetch, a matching URL opens the existing bookmark'; Round 2 client: 'all sound sufficient' (bare approval).
decisions.note: Implementation review. Reference REF-BM-02 requires metadata collected automatically on save; presented mechanism is a manual Fetch button (evidence supports a separate user-triggered action, not auto-on-save) → divergent. Client gives only bare approval, so no corrective response or explicit expression of the difference; awareness not inferable from approval.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker bulk actions: 'read-later / archive / add-tags / delete'; Round 2 client bare approval.
decisions.note: Implementation review. Reference REF-BM-20 bulk actions include add AND remove tags; presented set offers only add-tags (remove-tags absent) → partial divergence. Client bare-approves; difference not expressed.

decisions.evidence: Round 2 maker presents read-later & archive sidebar views, saved searches, local HTML+screenshot snapshots, Netscape HTML import/export; Round 2 client: 'This does what I need... organization, search, read-later and archive views, saved searches, snapshots, and import/export all sound sufficient'.
decisions.note: Implementation review. These deliveries conform to the co-constructed reference items; client's final bare approval accepts conforming work. Recorded conforming decision (not a capture — approval alone), no divergence.
